description: Use this when someone asks what an abbreviation or term means: "What is a UFI?", "What does DoP mean?", "Was ist eine Leistungserklärung?". Looks up one term in ProofPass’s glossary by name or abbreviation (e.g. "UFI", "SDB", "Leistungserklärung", "GPSR") and returns the definition, the explanation, its sources and related terms. The glossary is written in German. Do not use for how-to questions or duties (use search_knowledge or check_duties) or for abbreviations outside product rules and chemicals, such as SDS in software. The glossary is written in German.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: get_glossary_term
title: Look up a glossary term
